shortDescription: A group of 10 banks is providing a $22 billion chip loan to support Blackstone NYSE:BX and Alphabet's NASDAQ:GOOG new cloud venture Crux AI, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing  people with knowledge of the matter.
